content: Igla ibele taboloh yai hapatpat — semal mal le iy mele yebe lamli pangal mokwe lamliyel mala temal, ila ye wochog semal boy irel yodla ye chil yalwich le ila mwo iy mele ye lamli pangal formel.
Irel yodla ye chil yalwich ngo yor rechokla re kekamale ngo re kekamahoy ngali mekla lamliyal yee, la hola yodla mala temal sa faesul hatugulu.
Wol ila sengach bo imol molwe sibe medaf irel pangal formel, ngo si mel bo layur slave yalus kala re lamli faileng.
Ngo ligdi bo yela hola yodla ye faesul tugul ngo Deus sa fangdoh mala spegil Lol. Ye subdoh le semal yarmat mala sil, iwe ngo iy ye mel fael Hatobtob we yar Jews,
bo yebe demerir rechokla re mel fael Hatobtob we, bo fael mala be yoh le sibe mel bo lol Deus.
Deus yesa fang Espritu Santus la lamliyal mala Lol bo be mel lal depach bo mil mala yebe kawraloh le gich lol. Iwe ngo Espritu Santus mele ye ma foru bo gich sibe ma sor bo, “Temay, Temay.”
Ila hami ha taymel bo hami slave bo hasa mel le lol Deus. Iwe ngo mala hasa mel le lol Deus, ila Deus bele fang ngalugmi pangal mekla ye itol bo yar mekla lol.
Paulus Sa Merah Irer Galatians
Muswe ngo ha togla Deus. Iwe ha sala mel bo layur sibis yalus slave le te ir deus.

Iwe ngo igla ila hasa gola Deus — hare ibe far sor bo, igla ila Deus sa golahmi; meda mele ye foru le hala dipli bo habe tefael ngalir yalus kala re tayikel ngo tor pelar iyang? Meda mele hala dipli bo habe chil mel bo layur slave iyang?
Hama itol chog dipmi irel katot chog ral, mo meram, mo bong, mo raeg.
Isa merah iremi! Ifa sengal, pangal yengang kowe iforu bo yaglugmi ngo tor loh pelal?
Hami rewol bisiy, ibe hafalpechehmi bo habe mel le habe wochog ngang. Ngang semal yarmat le ihafedeg ngalugmi chog. Tor mele ha faor ngalyey le ye tayikof.
Ha chil gola le metamo ngo ye yoh yai foloyu ngalugmi Hapatpat Momay we le fael tomay we yai.

Ila mwo iwe lepal yami weres irel tomay we yai, ngo hami hate tolpagiliyey loh hare ha tahcheyeyloh. Ye momay yami hagiyeg ngalyey le ye wochog bo ha fofor molwe ngal semal angelusel lang, hare Kristus Jesus.
Ye kkel yami rraey irel yodwe. Meda mele sa wel igla? Be yoh le ngang ibe sor le irel yodwe ngo teyoholchog le habe haltu mekla metami hasa fang ngalyey.
Hasa yitili le ngang isa hattohar ngalugmi igla irel mala ikekangalugmi mekla ye katos?
Rechokla sibis ila ye kkel deper le rebe wegedi dipmi, ngo ligdi bo mekla re luluwaley ila ye tayikof. Mala chog re luluwaley ila rebe hasugmi tangiyey bo fael mala be wol kkel dipmi ngalir.
Ye momay le be kkel dipmi irel sew formel hare ye momay mekla ha luluwaley habe foru — mele ila te yodkla chog ima mel iremi bo pangal yad ngo ye katos.
Hami rewol layi le ihachangugmi! Isa wochog semal fefel kowe le bele dimolow, ila sa iye sengal chog bbaregel depey le fal hami yee, la hola yodla hasa mel le redabeyel Kristus iyang.
Iyalyal bo hare imel iremi igla bo ibe kangalugmi yai luluwal iremi. Yesa kkel yai merah iremi!
Kofal Hagar Mo Sarah
Widyey ibe cho kasiyahmi rechokla ha dipli bo habe dabey mala Hatobtob we ye sor: ha ted medaf irel mekla Hatobtob we ye sor?
Ye sor le Abraham ila rumal lol tarmal. Semal ila layur fengal mo semal fefel le semal slave, iwe ngo ila semal ila layur fengal mo fefel we ril we te semal slave.
Tarmal la lol mo uwol fefel we semal slave, ila ye subdoh le igegel chog yar yarmat ma subdoh. Ngo iwe lol mo uwol fefel we ril, ila ye subdoh le fael promise we yael Deus.

Meka ila sibe madefagili le sew fiyongol hawewe. Fefel le rumal ila re wochog bogtag we ruwow. Fefel we ye subdoh molwe lol le semal slave ila Hagar. Iwe ngo iy mele ye wochog bogtag we ye ffaor mo woal tayitel Sinai.
Irel yach hawewe ngo sibe sor bo Hagar mele tayitel Sinai we ye mel woal Arabia. Sibe wol haweweli ngal Jerusalem igla le sa panger yarmat iyang ngo resa rol mel bo slave.
Iwe ngo Jerusalem la ye mel woal laeng ila te iy slave, iwe ngo iy mele selach.
Iwe babior we ye santus ye sor bo,

content.text: “Hobe rraey gel fefel la ted yor mwo yalwich le ho dimolowagili!
Hobe ttawul ngo ho tang irel yam rraey bo ho ted meyafi mwo bbarger rechokla rema dimolow!
Bo fefel we resa tahchaloh ila be cholop lol
mo imol fefel la mala ril te tahchaloh.”

content: Hami rewol bisiy, igla ila hasa mel bo lol Deus le fael promise we yal Deus ngalgich, le ye wochog yael Isaac subdoh bo lol Abraham le fael promise we yael Deus.
Irel yodla ngo yalwich mal we ye subdoh le wululul chog yar yarmat ma subdoh, ila ye hafohoyu iwe ye subdoh le fael Espritu Santus la lamiliyel Deus. Iwe ngo ye chil ila sengal chog igla.

Iwe ngo meda mele babior we ye santus ye sor? Babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Ha fangloh slave fefel la mo yalwich mal la lol; bo mala lol fefel la iy slave, ila re towe bugatgat sew mo mala lol fefel la te iy slave.”
Ila hami rewol bisiy, gich ila te gich lol fefel la iy slave, bo gich lol fefel la te iy slave.
